visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a park at dusk. A long, clean stone-paved path stretches into the distance under a pale sky. On the right, a large, ancient-looking tree with sprawling branches is decorated with strings of triangular flags in yellow, green, and orange. Modern low-rise buildings with warm lights are visible in the background. (2) The perspective shifts to a night view. A person wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans walks down a lit stone walkway toward a wooden building. String lights hang from the building's roofline, casting a warm glow on the surrounding greenery and pavement. (3) The scene moves inside a brightly lit restaurant. The interior features white tiled walls, wooden tables, and mismatched wooden chairs. Large photo menus are taped to the wall above the service area, creating a casual, welcoming atmosphere. (4) A close-up shows a hand selecting a manga book from a densely packed bookshelf, followed by a finger pressing a tooth on a green plastic crocodile toy on a table. (5) High-detail food shots follow: a bowl of spicy orange-colored noodles with ribs, shrimp, and clams is shown. A spoon lifts the broth, and chopsticks pull up thick wavy noodles. (6) Another dish is presented: a plate of five golden-brown pan-fried buns. A bun is picked up with chopsticks, showing its juicy interior and then being dipped into the spicy noodle soup. (7) A bowl of rice topped with pork and green vegetables in a brown sauce is displayed, followed by close-ups of a pink strawberry shake, an iced tea float with vanilla ice cream, and a small glass bowl of strawberry-topped panna cotta. (8) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the restaurant at night. The blue doors are closed, and a wooden sign with glowing letters reads '日月私饗' under a string of festive lights.
